decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD in a warehouse-backed catalog costs almost nothing to keep listed, and its long-tail collector demand is still an open option worth holding.
The illustrated release series is a multi-model line that builds on the label's core strength, and each new volume adds further options at low marginal cost, so abandoning it is not justified.
The jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's goal of broadening genres and formats, and with no evidence of failure and minimal holding cost it stays in the catalog until stock runs out.
The box set's main production cost is already sunk, and keeping remaining stock on sale for collectors is cheap, though a limited pressing could eventually sell out of print.
The compilation CD had lower visibility, which suggests weaker prospects, but delisting saves little in a 60,000-item catalog, so keeping the option open remains rational.
